-- Creating external tables in bronze schema for airport

IF OBJECT_ID('bronze.Airport') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.Airport;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.Airport
(
    Code VARCHAR(10),
    [Description] VARCHAR(100)
)

WITH (
            LOCATION = 'L_AIRPORT.csv',  
            DATA_SOURCE = USOnTimeProject_Lookup,  
            FILE_FORMAT = csv_file_format_pv1,
            REJECT_VALUE = 10,
            REJECTED_ROW_LOCATION = 'Rejections/Airport'
    );

SELECT * FROM bronze.Airport;

-- Creating external tables in bronze schema for calendar

IF OBJECT_ID('bronze.Calendar') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.Calendar;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.Calendar
(
        date_key        INT,
        date            DATE,
        year            SMALLINT,
        month           TINYINT,
        day             TINYINT,
        day_name        VARCHAR(10),
        day_of_year     SMALLINT,
        week_of_month   TINYINT,
        week_of_year    TINYINT,
        month_name      VARCHAR(10),
        year_month      INT,
        year_week       INT
)

WITH (
            LOCATION = 'L_CALENDAR.csv',  
            DATA_SOURCE = USOnTimeProject_Lookup,  
            FILE_FORMAT = csv_file_format_pv1,
            REJECT_VALUE = 0,
            REJECTED_ROW_LOCATION = 'Rejections/Calendar'
    );

SELECT * FROM bronze.Calendar;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.Time
(
        TimeSKey        SMALLINT,
        TimeKey         SMALLINT,
        TimeValue       TIME(0),
        Time_24_Hour    VARCHAR(10),
        Time_12_Hour    VARCHAR(10),
        HourNumber      TINYINT,
        MinuteNumber    TINYINT,
        PartOfDay       VARCHAR(10),
